teaser.en: A modest coastal shrub that does many jobs at once: medicine, firewood, building poles and a patch of shade.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha kawaida cha pwani kinachofanya kazi nyingi kwa wakati mmoja: dawa, kuni, nguzo za ujenzi na kivuli.

summary.en: *Mkalakala* is a shrub or small tree of the coastal bushland with small berries. Its leaves and roots are used as medicine, and its wood for fuel and building poles.
summary.sw: *Mkalakala* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa vichaka vya pwani wenye matunda madogo. Majani na mizizi yake hutumika kama dawa, na mbao zake kwa kuni na nguzo za ujenzi.

about.en: *Mkalakala* is a shrub or small tree with leaves arranged alternately along the stems and small, round berries. It belongs to the same family as the coastal golden-leaf (*mdudu*), and shares that family's neat, simple leaves with clear side veins.
about.sw: *Mkalakala* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani yaliyopangwa kwa kupishana kando ya mashina, na matunda madogo ya mviringo. Ni wa familia moja na *mdudu* (kwa Kiingereza *coastal golden-leaf*), na unashiriki majani nadhifu, sahili ya familia hiyo, yenye mishipa ya pembeni inayoonekana wazi.

uses.en: Leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine. The wood is used as firewood and for building poles, and the tree is left standing for its shade.
uses.sw: Majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa za kienyeji. Mbao zake hutumika kwa kuni na kwa nguzo za ujenzi, na mti huachwa umesimama kwa ajili ya kivuli chake.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mkalakala* and *mwambeberu*; ICRAF's handbook gives *mkalakala*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mnembenembe* or *mkarati*. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Bridelia cathartica*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mkalakala* na *mwambeberu*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mkalakala*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mnembenembe* au *mkarati*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Bridelia cathartica*.

reason.en: Another coastal bush shrub used as medicine
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha vichaka vya pwani kinachotumika kama dawa
